Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor 
maintenance procedure P1 for the boiler valves, which must be carried out when 
the gas turbine have minor maintenance after 4000 workhour.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mamdooh 
ElSayed Ghazy, tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Allah at 19 Jan 
2003 on Boiler no. 1 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel 
Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
HRSG must be out of 
 service.
Depressurized if need or 
 isolate if possible
Drain line if need
Tools and Equipment
Spanner 
 & gasket & spacer ring
Driver & 
 alin keys & cleaning liquid
Blanco & 
 anti seize
Work to be Carried Out
Gate Valves 
There are size from ( 2 to 24) 
VELAN-Canada
Clean from foreign material
Lap the gate wear or cracks or change the defect gate.
Lap the seat wear or change the defect seat if possible.
Make machining for stem or replace the defect.
Retighten for gasket leakage or replace the defect
Retighten the gland if leakage or replace

There are size from ( 1/2 to 24) 
NUOVO PIGNONE-ITALY
Clean from foreign material
Lap the plug wear or cracks or change the defect plug.
Lap the seat wear or change the defect seat if possible.
Make machining for stem or replace the defect.
Retighten for gasket leakage or replace the defect.
Retighten the gland if leakage or replace.

Lap the plug wear or cracks or change the defect ball.
Lap the seat wear or change the defect seat if possible
Make machining for stem or replace the defect
Retighten for gasket leakage or replace the defect
Retighten the gland if leakage or replace.

Retighten for gasket leakage or replace the defect

{ECO, DRUM, SUPER .} 
DESCO-ITALY
Measure the adjust span before opening.
Clean from foreign material.
Check the spring replace the defect.
Lap the plug wear or cracks or change the defect plug.
Lap the seat wear or change the defect seat.

Retighten for gasket leakage or replace the defect.

Valves
